solutions.title: Active Comp Context Review

intent.summary: Inspect active composition, selected layers and optional render queue state without changing the project.
appliesWhen: The user asks to summarize the active comp, selected layers or render queue state.
The planner needs compact read-only context before deciding whether a later mutation is safe.

targetAssumptions: The CEP panel may be offline; offline context should be reported instead of guessed.

verificationRecipe.summary: Confirm the plan uses only typed read tools and reports returned context or offline state.

notes: Seeded from the Project Context Snapshot workflow and offline prompt smoke coverage.

promotionHistory.evidence: Milestone 71 seed from existing read-only context snapshot and prompt smoke validation.

notes: This recipe is advisory context only and must not add mutation steps.

solutions.title: Basic Comp Setup Typed Plan

intent.summary: Create one basic composition with explicit size, duration and frame rate, then read it back.
appliesWhen: The user asks to create a simple or basic composition.
The planner needs a narrow comp creation pattern before adding layers or effects.

inputs.name: compName
inputs.description: Requested composition name.

inputs.name: compSettings
inputs.description: Explicit width, height, duration, frame rate and optional background color.

targetAssumptions: The requested comp is a new generated project item.
The workflow does not require broad comp updates or template batch changes.

verificationRecipe.summary: Read back the created comp and confirm name, dimensions, duration and frame rate.
steps: Run get_comp_details after create_comp.
Compare the returned comp metadata with the requested settings.
expectedEvidence: The created comp reports the expected name, size, duration and frame rate.
The mutating step includes idempotency and read-back verification.

notes: Seeded as a Dakkshin-inspired advisory recipe using existing create_comp typed-tool coverage.

promotionHistory.evidence: Milestone 187 advisory solution-library slice from M186 recommended help/prompt entries.

notes: Advisory recipe only; execution still uses normal Agent plan validation and protected run gates.

solutions.title: Safe Effect Addition Typed Plan

inputs.name: targetLayer
inputs.description: Selected layer or explicit layer target verified before adding the effect.

solutions.title: Calculate Distance Between Layers Typed Plan

intent.summary: Report Euclidean distance between two layers from read-only transform position evidence.
appliesWhen: The user asks to calculate or measure the distance between two layers.
The workflow needs read-only layer position measurement without moving, aligning or otherwise mutating layers.

inputs.name: layerPair
inputs.description: Exactly two selected or explicitly identified layers verified by typed read-back before distance is reported.

inputs.name: measurementTime
inputs.description: Optional sample time in seconds; omit to use the active comp current time or typed-tool default sample time.

targetAssumptions: An active composition exists and the two target layers are read before reporting distance.
Layer distance is computed from typed read-back transform position values, not from layer bounds, anchor points, parenting offsets or rendered pixels.
Multiple selected layers require asking for a concrete pair instead of guessing which two layers to measure.
If position values are unavailable from typed read-back, the workflow reports a typed-tool gap rather than falling back to raw script execution.

verificationRecipe.summary: Read active comp and two layer positions, then confirm the reported value equals Euclidean distance from the cited coordinates.
steps: Run get_active_comp before reporting to capture active comp identity and current time when available.
Run get_selected_layers when the request targets selected layers, and bind exactly two concrete layerIndex values from that evidence.
Run get_layer_details for both target layers and read transform position evidence from the same comp and sample-time context.
Compute Euclidean distance from the two cited position values, including z only when both positions include numeric z components.
Fail closed when fewer or more than two layers are selected without an explicit pair, or when position evidence is unavailable.
expectedEvidence: Layer-distance plans include get_selected_layers evidence before selected layer indices are bound.
get_layer_details read-back shows usable position values for both target layers in the same comp.
The reported distance equals the Euclidean distance computed from the cited coordinates.
The response reports ambiguous selection or missing position evidence as a typed-tool gap instead of mutating layers.
